text:
Taylor: hi all 1st day here. trying to enable cloud functions in eu-west1 but `gcloud services enable cloudfunctions.googleapis.com` errors with a billing/permission hint. i linked what i thought was the team billing account but still blocked. any quick checks?
Cloud Onboarding Bot: welcome Taylor! common causes: 1) billing account not enabled for the folder/org, 2) org policy restricting services or regions, 3) project-level IAM missing serviceusage.serviceUsable. paste the error and project id.
Taylor: error:
ERROR: (gcloud.services.enable) PERMISSION_DENIED: The project 'proj-taylor-day1' cannot enable service 'cloudfunctions.googleapis.com' because billing is not enabled or allowed
proj id: proj-taylor-day1
Taylor: i did `gcloud beta billing projects describe proj-taylor-day1` and it shows linkedBillingAccount: 01B2-C3D4-E5F6
Priya (billing): that billing id looks like a legacy shared account. we require team-level billing accounts for sandbox projects. can you confirm the billing account is active and has 'Billing Account User' role for your IAM principal? run `gcloud alpha billing accounts get-iam-policy 01B2-C3D4-E5F6`.
Taylor: ran it, my user isn't listed. i thought linking was automatic.
Sam (infra): two parts: 1) if billing is wrong we'll see a PERMISSION_DENIED on enable; 2) occasionally org folder blocks service enablement (`constraints/disableServiceUsage`) for security. run `gcloud org-policies describe constraints/compute.restrictServiceCreation --folder=FOLDER_ID --effective` to check.
Taylor: folder id is folders/334455
Sam (infra): checking... folder has a policy that blocks `cloudfunctions.googleapis.com` for prod folders but not for dev. strange. i see an explicit deny on service usage at the project level inherited from a blueprint. i'll open ticket.
Ruth (onboard-eng): if billing is the blocker, easiest is to move the project under the team-dev billing account: 01D4-E5F6-G7H8. Priya can you confirm if that's allowed for new-hires?
Priya (billing): yes we can accept the move for sandbox projects. we need a short request: project id, source billing id, target billing id, and manager approval. i'll do the transfer once infra confirms no org deny.
Ivy (security): FYI security blocks functions with external runtime downloads in certain EU folders. if you're using third-party runtimes, we need an exception. Otherwise fine for non-prod.
Taylor: i'm using standard nodejs runtime and nothing external. opened a ticket to move billing: TKT-2026-332, included manager note.
Sam (infra): i filed infra ticket POL-2026-997 to remove the inherited disableServiceUsage for cloudfunctions.googleapis.com on proj-taylor-day1 once billing is moved. noted dependency on billing.
Priya (billing): billing transfer completed. project now linked to 01D4-E5F6-G7H8 and you have billing.accounts.get role.
Sam (infra): infra updated org policy exception; you should now be able to enable the API. try: `gcloud services enable cloudfunctions.googleapis.com --project=proj-taylor-day1`
Taylor: ran it 1 works! function deploy next. thanks everyone.
Ruth (onboard-eng): small onboarding doc update request: add "check billing owner list and org service-deny policies" to the enable-service troubleshooting steps. can someone create a short gist or internal doc?
Priya (billing): i'll add a short checklist to the onboarding playbook and link ticket numbers.
Taylor: appreciate it! :thumbsup:
